hypotheses.statement: Broad lstrip('./') removes the leading dot from .github paths.
assumptions: the observed output is not post-processed
falsifiers: an exact-prefix implementation still loses the leading dot

hypotheses.statement: Fixture serialization removes the leading dot before the normalizer sees the value.
falsifiers: raw fixture bytes preserve the leading dot

hypotheses.statement: Operating-system path semantics remove the leading dot.
assumptions: the path library applies platform-specific normalization
falsifiers: the same behavior reproduces on independent operating systems

hypotheses.statement: A caller strips punctuation after normalize_path returns.
assumptions: the direct normalizer output was not inspected
falsifiers: a direct call already returns github/workflows/ci.yml
